content.text:
Plan submitted — all 18 rules searched and routed.

Highlights for the reviewing team:

- **Structure note:** this is a co-development/funding agreement, not a typical vendor services contract, so several rules map onto atypical clauses (funding caps instead of purchase minimums, Buy-Out Payments instead of termination fees).
- **Likely absent:** MFN (only a lender-protection "not less favorable" standard at p0543) and RENEWAL (fixed Term, no auto-renewal).
- **Highest-risk areas flagged for substantive review:** SFJ's ownership of the Trial Data Package/Research Results (p0663) with assign-back at p0783; the Program Transfer mechanic (p0375–p0376) that moves our Product business to SFJ on default triggers; the Change of Control Buy-Out Payment (p0530) coupled with the consent-based assignment clause (p0814); ICDR arbitration (p0824, p0831); and the one-sided representation package in Article 13 with the 13.6 disclaimer.
- **Do-not-flag:** the Section 3.19 exclusivity commitment runs against SFJ and benefits us.
